content:
The Flood

In the rainy season of last year, the river behind our town overflowed its banks. The water rose quickly and entered many houses. People carried their belongings to higher ground, and the town crier warned everyone to move to the school building, which stood on a hill. The rain continued for three days. When it finally stopped, the water slowly went down, but many houses were damaged, and several farms were destroyed. The people of the town did not lose hope. They worked together to clear the mud, repair their houses, and replant their farms. The government also sent relief materials. The flood taught the people an important lesson: they must not build houses too close to the river.

content:
The Football Match

The final match of the inter-house sports competition was between Blue House and Red House. The whole school gathered on the field to watch. In the first half, Red House scored two goals, and their supporters cheered loudly. Blue House did not give up. Their captain, Tunde, encouraged his teammates, and in the second half, they played with new energy. Tunde scored one goal, and five minutes later, his friend Emeka scored another. The score was now two goals each. In the last minute of the game, Tunde received a pass, ran past two defenders, and scored the winning goal. Blue House won the match three goals to two. The principal praised both teams for their good sportsmanship.
